openings.discriminator: Hold agreed historical scope constant; independently vary assignments and names. Compare baseline, temporal-only, identity-only and combined selectors, including combined changes.

openings.fit: Diagnostic sessions preserve constraints; confirmation UI and rerun feasibility uncertain.

decision: Diagnose before selecting one bounded change. Share six engineer-days and existing hosting; retain private authorized processing, documented CSV and attendance entry. Validate next 40 exports: median handling <=12 minutes, intended sets >=95%, zero foreign-center records. Sampled isolation excludes the split center.
